02The rules under the replay

First-class

A memory is an append-only graph entity, not hidden model state.

Attachable

Any entity can remembers a memory; the thing carries it into work.

Borrowed

--memory injects a one-session loan and writes nothing to the graph.

Ordered

The persona working set precedes task-remembered memories at spawn.

Why asynchronous? With current model limitations, an agent cannot efficiently garden its own memory while also doing the task. Dispatcher prepares context before the session starts; Dreamer consolidates and challenges claims later. The working session stays focused and leaves inspectable evidence.

A wrong memory is not erased. Pinned evidence can mark it with disputes, or a new memory can replace it with supersedes. The old entity remains because the record of what was believed is itself useful.

03Where today ends

The graph vocabulary is broader than the running behavior. Two inks keep that boundary visible.

Solid ink · shipped

  • A loop is an entity.
  • triggered_by inbound edges are its run history.
  • spell is a registered kind.
  • equips and pulled graph plumbing exists.

Ghost ink · not built

Spell casting has no runtime today. Hook machinery and event-triggered injection are design, not shipped behavior.

event → hook → cast spell → live session
